episodes.title: What Is Statistics?
episodes.description: Explore statistics as a tool for everyday choices and learn why its misuse can mislead.

episodes.title: Mathematical Thinking
episodes.description: Develop numerical understanding across very large and small scales to support better judgments.

episodes.title: Mean, Median, and Mode: Measures of Central Tendency
episodes.description: Compare different averages and what their central positions reveal about a dataset.

episodes.title: Measures of Spread
episodes.description: Explore how dispersion helps assess averages and the reliability of conclusions drawn from data.

episodes.title: Charts Are Like Pasta – Data Visualization Part 1
episodes.description: Compare charts and histograms while learning how visual presentation can inform or mislead.

episodes.title: Plots, Outliers, and Justin Timberlake: Data Visualization, Part 2
episodes.description: Use dot, box, and stem-and-leaf plots to examine data and identify unusual observations.

episodes.title: The Shape of Data: Distributions
episodes.description: Use samples and distribution shapes to infer patterns in a larger population.

episodes.title: Correlation Doesn’t Equal Causation
episodes.description: Examine relationships between variables through scatterplots and measures of correlation.

episodes.title: Controlled Experiments
episodes.description: Explore controls, blinding, randomization, and placebos as tools for reducing experimental bias.

episodes.title: Sampling Methods and Bias with Surveys
episodes.description: Recognize problematic survey wording and compare ways of choosing representative samples.

episodes.title: Science Journalism
episodes.description: Evaluate reporting about research by spotting weak studies, exaggerated claims, and misleading presentation.

episodes.title: Henrietta Lacks, the Tuskegee Experiment, and Ethical Data Collection
episodes.description: Connect historical research abuses with informed consent, ethical review, and new challenges in digital data collection.

episodes.title: Probability, Part 1 – Rules and Patterns
episodes.description: Calculate event likelihoods using addition, multiplication, and conditional probability rules.

episodes.title: Probability, Part 2 – Updating Your Beliefs with Bayes
episodes.description: Introduce Bayesian reasoning, simulations, and the behavior of results across many observations.

episodes.title: The Binomial Distribution
episodes.description: Use binomial and Bernoulli models to calculate probabilities for repeated outcomes.

episodes.title: Geometric Distributions and The Birthday Paradox
episodes.description: Explore waiting-time probabilities and the surprising likelihood of shared birthdays.

episodes.title: Randomness
episodes.description: Describe unpredictable events using expected values, variability, asymmetry, and other distribution features.

episodes.title: Z-Scores and Percentiles
episodes.description: Standardize measurements with z-scores and compare their positions using percentiles.

episodes.title: The Normal Distribution
episodes.description: Explore the normal curve and why averages often follow it through the central limit theorem.

episodes.title: Confidence Intervals
episodes.description: Use interval estimates to describe uncertainty and examine the tradeoff between precision and confidence.

episodes.title: How P-Values Help Us Test Hypotheses
episodes.description: Introduce null-hypothesis testing and the role of p-values in assessing unexpected observations.

episodes.title: P-Value Problems
episodes.description: Examine misinterpretations, arbitrary thresholds, and limitations of p-value reasoning.

episodes.title: Playing with Power: P-Values, Part 3
episodes.description: Compare false positives and missed effects while investigating statistical power.

episodes.title: You Know I’m All About that Bayes
episodes.description: Update beliefs as evidence arrives using Bayes's theorem and Bayesian hypothesis testing.

episodes.title: Bayes in Science and Everyday Life
episodes.description: Apply Bayesian inference to continuous measurements and practical scientific and everyday problems.

episodes.title: Test Statistics
episodes.description: Use test statistics to compare observations with expectations and connect critical values with p-values.

episodes.title: T-Tests – A Matched Pair Made in Heaven
episodes.description: Compare independent-sample and paired t-tests through a practical coffee-tasting example.

episodes.title: Degrees of Freedom and Effect Sizes
episodes.description: Distinguish independent information in a model from the practical importance of its measured effects.

episodes.title: Chi-Square Tests
episodes.description: Compare categorical data with goodness-of-fit, independence, and homogeneity tests.

episodes.title: P-Hacking
episodes.description: Recognize selective analysis that produces misleading significance and learn ways to avoid it.

episodes.title: The Replication Crisis
episodes.description: Examine problems with reproducing analyses and replicating studies, together with proposed improvements.

episodes.title: Regression
episodes.description: Build a regression model to describe relationships within the broader general linear framework.

episodes.title: ANOVA
episodes.description: Use analysis of variance to compare differences among three or more groups.

episodes.title: ANOVA Part 2: Dealing with Intersectional Groups
episodes.description: Extend analysis of variance to groups whose memberships overlap and interact.

episodes.title: Fitting Models is Like Tetris
episodes.description: Explore covariance adjustments and repeated-measures models to reduce error and compare conditions.

episodes.title: Supervised Machine Learning
episodes.description: Compare logistic regression, discriminant analysis, and nearest-neighbor methods for predicting labeled outcomes.

episodes.title: Unsupervised Machine Learning
episodes.description: Explore clustering methods that organize information without predefined categories.

episodes.title: Intro to Big Data
episodes.description: Examine how records of online behavior become data used for profiling and recommendations.

episodes.title: Big Data Problems
episodes.description: Consider privacy, security, bias, and transparency challenges created by large-scale data analysis.

episodes.title: Statistics in the Courts
episodes.description: Explore courtroom cases where statistical mistakes contributed to serious consequences.

episodes.title: Neural Networks
episodes.description: Introduce layered computational models inspired by neurons and their applications to complex data.

episodes.title: War
episodes.description: Explore statistical contributions to wartime codebreaking, production estimates, and locating submarines.

episodes.title: When Predictions Fail
episodes.description: Investigate flawed predictions through limited evidence, biased models, and polling errors.

episodes.title: When Predictions Succeed
episodes.description: Explore successful forecasting and decisions in retail, baseball, and weather prediction.
